name: DocumentChase
description: Every hour on the hour, 08:00–17:00 Israel time, Sunday to Thursday, runs DocumentChasePipeline (CheckDocumentScans): finished scans become a customer package draft, a missing scan past logisticsReminderHours gets a logistics reminder draft, and one past it again is escalated to the collections manager. Output lands in Disputes, Approvals (drafts only, nothing is sent) and Interactions.
